info.title: 小猫回家记：框架 API
info.description:
浏览器 Demo 已实现的 API。开发地址 http://127.0.0.1:8017；前端 5017 代理 /api/v1。

会话：POST /api/v1/sessions 无正文，返回 playerId、token；其余玩家接口使用 Authorization: Bearer <token>。

写命令：POST /api/v1/commands，Content-Type: application/json，Idempotency-Key 为 8–128 位字母数字、下划线或连字符；正文为 expectedRevision + command，最多 8 KiB。

请求示例：{"expectedRevision":0,"command":{"type":"ADVANCE_STORY","nodeId":"prologue_1"}}。成功返回 {state,replayed}。

同键同正文重试返回原结果；replayed=true 后再 GET /api/v1/state。网络异常或 5xx 保留原键、正文重试；409 版本冲突读取最新状态。不得提交骰子、抽奖结果、价格、余额或任意完整存档。

错误格式：{error:{code,message,requestId}}。400 请求无效；401 会话无效；409 阶段、版本、资格或资源冲突；413 超大正文；415 内容类型；500 内部错误。

当前战斗胜负由客户端原型上报；主题包裹、剧情家具赠送与模拟支付已实现；真实支付尚未接入。x-planned 中仅列后续约定，不是可调用 paths。

post.description: 有效会话必需。缺省battle核对活动场次；journey核对sceneKey及expectedRevision。explore_hint只改写地图当前批准的一句本地提示，限一二四五章探索，不接问题/历史/内部目标ID，context须为ExploreHintObservation的JSON字符串。返回前核对相关进度。问答最多12秒，探索短提示最多4秒，无自动重试；source=local时保留当前本地文字。现有限流、全局并发与日预算继续生效，自动提示会话槽独立于主动聊天。接口不执行命令、不改变revision。正文最多128KiB。

bearerAuth.description: 匿名会话返回的随机令牌，存储仅保存其 SHA-256 哈希。

mainline.description: True for a battle entered through its gated chapter map; home trials remain independent.

qa.description: Server-owned marker preserving QA attribution through settlement and the later return command.

draws.description: 本次一份或十份包裹的有序收据；前端拆包后才呈现对应家具。

pushTokens.description: 伙伴鼓励次数:掷两组 2d6 取优;初始 1,塔防胜利恢复(上限 2)

qaCheckpointId.description: 可选的当前验收节点；验收前快照仅保存在服务端，可用 QA_RESTORE 返回。

homeLayout.description: 可选的家具布置覆盖；furniture:家具ID 或 stage:阶段:摆件ID，缺省兼容旧 placements。stored=true 收回背包。

homeRepairs.description: 已完成的场景修缮部位；旧存档可省略，阶段标记仍有效。

requireCat.description: 仅当队伍包含这只猫时选项可用;前端隐藏,服务端拒绝

advisorHint.description: 可选:选项级解释(如需要特定伙伴的原因);约束同卡级

requiresFlags.description: 事件链:全部剧情标记已记录时该卡才进随机池

repeatable.description: 回响卡:可重复抽到,不占无放回名额;奖励应保持近零

advisorHint.description: 可选:给阿策(advisor)的公开解释文本;不代选、不夹带结局文案、不剧透 flag 或其他事件卡

Stage.description: Dimensions specify the bounding box, not necessarily a filled rectangle. The stage module owns its playable cell outline; greenhouse_boss has 34 real cells inside a 6-row by 9-column box; tunnel_boss has 37 real cells inside a 5-row by 8-column box; finale_boss has 74 real cells inside a 7-row by 12-column box.

widthCm.description: 布置参考宽度（厘米）；同一世界比例显示，非战斗数值。

category.description: 布置分类：墙饰、装饰、桌子、小窝、座椅、收纳、绿植、地毯、灯具或玩具。

optionId.description: Optional attitude for prologue_banter or prologue_sneak; omitted by older clients.

usePush.description: 伙伴鼓励:消耗一枚,掷两组 2d6 取总和高的一组

StartBattle.description: Starts L01 first rescue (alley_rescue), unlocked home replay (alley_boss), or a standalone home trial (market_boss / greenhouse_boss / tunnel_boss / finale_boss) after alley_rescued. Warehouse exploration starts finale_boss as a mainline attempt after its authored boss interaction and preparation; victory unlocks the warehouse exit. Standalone trials do not require each other to be completed. Failed preparation may retry only the original stage, preserving the failed attempt pressure and carry snapshot in a new attempt ID. l00_tutorial is accepted only to retry a failed tutorial settlement and does not enable carry. No battle inventory reservation.

CompleteBattle.description: alley_rescue, alley_boss, market_boss, greenhouse_boss, tunnel_boss and finale_boss require report. l00_tutorial requires only attemptId and outcome. Battle completion grants no consumable supplies. Standalone market_boss / greenhouse_boss / tunnel_boss / finale_boss only record stage completion: no recruitment, items, currency, push tokens or story progression, and no clearing mainline pending event modifiers. Old active L01 reservations are fully returned in the durable, idempotent settlement transaction.

count.description: 可选；一次寄出一份或十份，默认保持单抽。十份在同一事务内结算，任一抽失败全部回滚。

DrawFurniture.description: 仅家园可抽取 moss_letters（每份1邮票）或 moonsea_observatory（每份60罐头）。count 可选1或10，默认1；每份沿用原权重、独立累计保底与重复补偿，十份原子结算。lastResult.draws 返回本批收据，draw 保留最后一份兼容旧客户端。涂画内容不上传、不影响结果。重试不重复结算。

BuyFurniture.description: 用猫爪邮票购买一件尚未拥有的家具；仅提交商品 ID，由服务端定价并原子扣费发货，不涉及真实付款。

RepairHome.description: 家园阶段推进下一项修缮；服务端按修缮目录检查前置条件、扣除材料与邮票并解锁对应位置。

repairId.description: 场景修补部位 ID；省略时兼容修缮本阶段剩余工程。

carry.description: Saved per-attempt carry. New event carries replace older ones; events without carry preserve it. L00 ignores carry, L01 wins clear pending, standalone L02/L03 trials preserve pending on either outcome. Unknown historical save IDs are ignored by battle consumers so the base battle can continue.
Optional newly awarded carry. Omission does not clear the prior pending carry; unknown configured values are invalid content.

BattleReport.description: Client-reported combat summary required for alley_rescue, alley_boss, market_boss, greenhouse_boss, tunnel_boss and finale_boss. Victory requires bossDefeated and fewer than 3 leaks. The prototype does not run server-authoritative combat. finale_boss additionally requires elitesDefeated in both outcomes, and a victory count of 2. The six main cats and fixed reinforcements do not create permanent recruits.

elitesDefeated.description: Required for finale_boss reports; victory additionally requires exactly 2 defeated elite guards. Other stages may omit it.

LegacyBattleReservation.description: Read-only compatibility for old active saves. Current battles cannot select or consume these items. All reserved units are returned atomically once when that active attempt settles; historical settled attempts are never refunded again.

BattleCarryId.description: Single temporary battle carry supplied by event handoffs MR !23, !24, !39 and !40. dog identifies Old Huang, dove the pigeon ally, rats the friendly rat squad, and kitten the rescued kitten. No inventory transfer or extra result fields.

context.description: 客户端白名单构建的当前可见信息JSON对象字符串，不能发送完整存档、未来剧情或隐藏事件结果；journey服务端另附当前可信进度。

scope.description: 缺省为既有战斗问答；journey为主动旅程问答；explore_hint为地图批准的自动短提示改写。

hint.description: 地图当前批准显示的本地情境提示；目标资格/远近/完成条件由地图判定。不能发送整张表、内部目标ID、隐藏内容或据坐标猜出的路线。

reason.description: 本地回退原因代码，不包含提供商响应正文或密钥。

username.description: 用户名，3~24 个字符，不含空格；存储时归一化为小写

password.description: 密码明文仅在请求中出现，服务端以 PBKDF2 加盐哈希存储

QALoadCheckpoint.description: GAME_QA_ENABLED=true 时从服务端白名单准备测试进度；首次进入前持久保存原进度，后续切换不覆盖快照。

QARestore.description: 恢复验收前的完整进度并保持版本号递增；即使验收开关关闭也允许返回自己的原进度。

QABattleResult.description: 服务端验收开关控制的胜负模拟；必须匹配当前活动场次，并走正常结算逻辑。

ClaimParcelReward.description: 仅家园可领取；北京时间每日重置日常，里程碑每档一次，条件与奖励全部由服务端判定。

category.description: 布置分类：墙饰、装饰、桌子、小窝、座椅、收纳、绿植、地毯、灯具或玩具。

commands.validation: 地图路线、任务门槛与区域解锁
伙伴状态、家具偏好与互动条件
前置条件、资源消耗与升级效果
摆放归属与槽位有效性
当前对话、选项条件、一次性效果与跳转
任务已完成、奖励未领取、原子发放
已拥有伙伴、成长条件、资源与技能门槛
家具实例、房间归属、占地、碰撞与数量
仅游戏内货币购买；服务端查价、校验资格与限购，原子扣费发货；客户端不得提交权威价格

paymentEndpoints.purpose: 未来创建真实付费订单，返回订单标识与支付动作；服务端查价并绑定可恢复的玩家身份
读取本人订单的支付与发货状态
支付渠道服务端通知，验证通知、核对订单、去重并驱动发货

x-planned.paymentRule: 服务端查价并绑定订单，验证渠道通知和金额，去重后原子发货；客户端返回页不发货。本期不接真实支付。
